_note: Week-4 response proposals per case. {placeholders} are filled from the case facts that correlate.py reads from Week-2 evidence, so no value is typed by hand. For SIEM cases the containment proposals and prohibited actions come from the Week-3 tickets and are NOT repeated here. Every T1 item is a proposal: it requires a recorded analyst decision (Simulation/analyst_decisions.jsonl) and is never executed by the pipeline. T0 items are read-only investigation steps.

tiers.T1: Response proposal - requires recorded analyst approval; executed out-of-band by a human
tiers.T2: Prohibited automation (Week-3 dispatcher hard block) - listed for completeness

NT-01.action: Confirm whether {scanner_ip} is an authorised scanner (scan window, change record).
If unauthorised: block {scanner_ip} from reaching {target_ip} at the internal firewall.
Review which of the {distinct_ports} probed ports on {target_ip} are open and close unneeded services.

SIEM-WEB-001.action: Resolve Week-2 gate 2: prove the row-level join between the firing trigger and the {request_count}-request group from {source_ip} before any source block.
Re-baseline the high-rate threshold ({threshold} req/min) against normal traffic for {top_path} and similar paths.

SIEM-WEB-004.action: Fix output encoding / input validation for the parameter used on {request_path}; add a Content-Security-Policy header.
Re-test {request_path} with the {instances} recorded payloads after the fix; confirm the WAF rule review outcome.

SIEM-AUTH-002.action: Disable SSH password authentication for {username} (PermitRootLogin prohibit-password / key-only).
Search the full {dataset} for 'Accepted password' from {source_ip}; reset {username} credentials only if a success is found.

LT-01.action: Block SSH from {source_ip} on host {host} (same source as SIEM-AUTH-002).
Confirm no successful login exists for the targeted accounts ({usernames}) on {host}.

SIEM-MAL-003.action: Remove {process_image} and its parent {parent_process} from the affected host after evidence preservation.
Add SHA256 {sha256} to the endpoint blocklist (Week-3 PB-02 proposal) and sinkhole the queried .lat domains.
Re-image the affected host if the hash verdict is malicious; monitor for connections to {destination_ip}:{destination_port}.

LT-03.action: Isolate {host} from the network and block egress to {target_ip}:{target_port}.
Terminate the bash process tree (ProcessGuid {process_guid}) and check {user} persistence (cron, shell rc files, authorized_keys).
Confirm whether the connection to {target_ip}:{target_port} succeeded (network_outcome is unknown in the evidence).

RT-04.action: Isolate {host} until the persistence entry is removed.
Restore {registry_key} to explorer.exe only and delete {payload_path}.
Collect and hash {dropper} before deletion for malware analysis.
Verify the next logon on {host} starts only userinit.exe -> explorer.exe (no payload child process).

LT-02.action: Match the {distinct_commands} distinct sudo commands against change records; no action unless unauthorised.

RT-02.action: Identify the session that cleared the Security log on {host} and confirm whether {account} activity was approved.
If unapproved: reset the {account} password and restrict share access ({shares}) from {source_ip}.
Forward Security logs from {host} to the SIEM so a future log clear cannot remove the only copy.

RT-03.action: Restrict WinRM on {host} to approved administration hosts.
Identify the remote client and account behind winrshost.exe on {host} from authentication logs.

NT-03.action: Attribute the {connection_records} connections on {src_ip} to a process (endpoint telemetry is not in the dataset).

NT-02.action: Rate-limit / inspect DNS from {client_ip} to {resolver_ip} for the {zone} zone.
Decode the {burst_count} chunk labels ({pattern}) to determine whether they carry data.

RT-01.action: Block {tool_path} execution and the tunnel destinations ({destinations}) on {host}.
Remove {tool_path} from {host} and review saved PuTTY/plink sessions.

SIEM-EXCH-005.action: Run Get-MailboxExportRequest on {host} to check the status of the export requests ({export_names}).
Check whether the export target files exist: {aspx_paths}.
Only after verification: remove the export requests and any created .aspx files on {host} (Week-3 lists automatic deletion as prohibited).
Review Exchange RBAC: remove the Mailbox Import Export role assignment made to {mailbox} ({role_assignments} assignments logged) unless it is approved.
Reset {mailbox} credentials if misuse of the account is confirmed.
